input.rationale: The diff fixes two bugs. First, `Trace(MatrixUnit(...)).doit()` used to return 0 for every square unit larger than 1x1; it now returns a KroneckerDelta, which is 1 for diagonal units. Second, it removes the `is_square` override that returned `Eq(...)`, so `is_square` now gives True/False/None and Trace of a non-square unit raises NonSquareMatrixError. Both candidates report both fixes correctly. A is split into two short, clear bullets but leaves out the NonSquareMatrixError consequence. B includes that consequence but packs everything into one overlong sentence. Either could be published. A's brevity fits the guide a little better.
